en: Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped riverside park toward a picturesque late‑19th‑century villa or inn with ornate gables and dormers. The building sits beside a river or canal bordered by a fence; trees and a garden occupy the foreground. In the distant background stands an industrial townscape with factory chimneys and several tall church spires. German‑style signage is attached to the main building's façade, but is not fully legible.
